authority: The six Character Design Systems 4 Extended boards explicitly specify these 34 workhorse constructions. They supersede the Phase 0 derived proposals for the same component names.
globalLaws: The existing seven-motif vocabulary is applied, never extended.
No new artifact is introduced by an Extended component.
POWER remains reserved for Expressive Moments and is forbidden on these workhorses.
Light and dark variants share identical geometry; only declared theme tokens change.
Aspect Ratio and Typography intentionally add no motif where the boards state NO MOTIF FIT.
